scope: Implementation study only, frozen after dense analytical results and before sparse runs. No change to candidate family, folds, losses, shrinkage, IRLS, dense decisions or original geometry protocol.
operator: Assemble the exact same horizontal/vertical second differences and sqrt(2) mixed differences as sparse COO then CSR. Solve the same weighted normal equations with scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve and MMD_AT_PLUS_A permutation. Four IRLS solves remain identical.

parity.cases: All 19 frozen analytical observed-input sets, including all 4 CV folds and all 18 candidates
parity.comparison: Same selected name, same per-candidate full fit accepted/rejected status, per-fold loss differences, full fitted field differences, forward/inverse output on observed points and triangle centroids

cost.measurement: Separate worker processes for each shape and implementation. Report lattice assembly wall time, three IRLS field-fit wall times and peak process RSS including imports. Dense 7245-node case is explicitly skipped. This is one field-fit component, not full 18-candidate CV selector or image rectification.
cost.reference: Synthetic residuals from a fixed sine/cosine field with seeded 0.03mm noise. No physical query score is used.

real_observations: Only inventory existing frozen observed-grid-geometry.npz dimensions, node count, complete rectangular extent, cell count and hashes. No neural inference and no full real-image or physical benchmark.
forbidden: do not tune solver based on physical gold
do not replace dense analytical results with sparse results
do not describe component solve time as end-to-end runtime
do not claim sparse implementation resolves ID, orientation, missing support or outlier failures
